ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there are two input terminals on the left, labeled A and B respectively, and they enter a logic gate block labeled "&". There is a small circle before the output terminal on the right side of the block, then it connects to output Y. Reasoning: The gate labeled "&" represents an AND gate, so the internal output of the block is AB; the small circle at the output terminal represents inversion, so the final output is the NAND result, namely Y = \overline{AB}.
